snippet.title: Paul - Early Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Paul is a turn-based combat game with a touch of chess, a slice of dungeon crawling, and a sprinkle of exploration. You can add it to your Steam wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4346090
The game is currently in development, and you can follow its progress on the itch.io devlog: https://blackpants.itch.io/paul/devlog

#turnbasedcombat #indiegame #dungeoncrawl
